findingDetails.title: appendLog accepts a short write as complete
findingDetails.summary: appendLog ignores fs.writeSync's returned byte count, then fsyncs and returns success; a short write can leave the event suffix permanently missing.
findingDetails.classification: static inference; a stubbed short-write result would confirm the failure path

findingDetails.title: The fallback state directory is shared across users on systems with a shared temp directory
findingDetails.summary: When XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is absent and os.tmpdir is shared, the fixed skilled-relaunch path can be pre-created by another account, causing ensureStateDir chmod to fail and denying relaunch state.
findingDetails.classification: conditional static inference; an isolated shared-temp fallback setup would confirm the denial path

findingDetails.title: The killer can signal a reused PID after its ancestry check
findingDetails.summary: The killer validates ancestry and liveness, reads the armed record, then signals the numeric PID; PID reuse in that interval can direct SIGTERM to a replacement process.
findingDetails.classification: low-probability static inference; an injected PID-reuse case or stable process handle would confirm or close the gap

searchLedger.hypothesis: The fallback state path is predictable and shared when XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is absent, allowing another user to pre-create it.

searchActions.result: The fallback uses os.tmpdir plus one fixed directory name, then chmods that path without checking owner.
The common killer fixture supplies XDG_RUNTIME_DIR, so it does not exercise the shared-temp fallback.

searchLedger.rationale: On a shared temp directory, another account can pre-create the fixed name; the user's subsequent chmod fails on the other-owned directory.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A process may exit and its numeric PID may be reused after ancestry validation but before SIGTERM.

searchActions.result: The ancestry check and liveness check use a numeric PID; a state-file read occurs before process.kill sends SIGTERM to the same number.

searchLedger.rationale: The target identity is not bound across the validation-to-signal interval, so PID reuse could redirect the signal.

searchLedger.invariant: A handoff path that resolves outside the trusted handoffs directory is rejected.

searchActions.result: The validator checks lexical containment and resolves the real directory, parent, and existing candidate before returning it.
Test source covers lexical traversal rejection.

searchLedger.rationale: The inspected validator resolves symlinks and rejects outside real paths.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No static path escape was found in the checked entry path.

searchLedger.invariant: Only one concurrent killer takes over a stale lock.

searchActions.result: The takeover mutex rechecks owner liveness before unlinking and exclusively creates the replacement lock.
Test source starts two contenders and asserts one signal.

searchLedger.rationale: The mutex, recheck, exclusive creation, and source test cover the selected concurrent takeover case.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No double-takeover path was identified for the inspected scenario.

searchLedger.invariant: A missing transcript must not be treated as idle and cause a signal.

searchActions.result: A missing transcript for the grace period returns false from waitForIdle before the signal branch.
Test source removes the transcript and checks the session is disarmed without a signal.

searchLedger.rationale: Sustained absence fails the idle check; the inspected scenario is covered in test source.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: The transcript-disappearance path returns before SIGTERM.
